sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:51

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:51:1
items.html:
And when AA in turn sorts for the sake of AVI, to correct them the first time, then the coupling of Atik, male and female, must precede it: As was explained above (page 638, the passage beginning “And it is necessary”), the coupling of AA does not suffice to sort the sortings of AVI, because he is only the lower half of the Keter. Rather, he must join and become one degree together with the Nukva of Atik, who is the upper half of the Keter of Nekudim; and then the Keter is in its wholeness as it was at the time of Nekudim, at the time when the Keter clothed as Mochin in AVI, who are the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] that rose, and then he will be able to correct them. See there.
And this is what he says: “The coupling of Atik, male and female, must precede it, and they return to draw new Mochin to AA and Nukva, so that they may sort the sortings of the parts of AVI, etc., and then the parts of AVI are corrected there within AA.” That is, as has been explained, AA joins with Atik into a single Partzuf, and AA acquires new Mochin through this joining of his. Then he has the illumination of the Keter in its wholeness, and he can correct the sortings of AVI, in such a way that the coupling is ascribed to Atik, but the one who sorts for the Mochin of AVI is only AA, for AA is that part of the Keter which was clothed in these AVI at the time of Nekudim as Mochin. And by virtue of this relation he sorts them now as well.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:51:2
items.html: The first are the original ones, to correct the Partzuf; the second are the new ones that are drawn in each and every coupling, etc.: For at first the two couplings of Katnut and Gadlut were made for the sake of the Partzuf itself, as above; and after the Partzuf itself was corrected, MAN [Mayin Nukvin] rise to it from the lower Partzufim, and they are regarded by it as new HG, since they are not for its own sake but for the sake of the lower ones. And know that all the Mochin are called by the name HG, for in all the couplings made by MAN there is no actual light of Hochma in them, but rather the discernment of HG in the illumination of Hochma, as above in part seven.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:51:3
items.html:
They do not remain there permanently, but are corrected and formed into the shape of an offspring: That is, in the manner explained above (page 628, the passage beginning “And After”), how the coupling of Atik, which is upon the MAN of the AHP of the Keter of BON, brought out upon them ten Sefirot in the degree of Hochma — these ten Sefirot did not remain in Atik permanently, but were corrected, and from them was made the Rosh of AA, which is the offspring born by this coupling. And in this manner every lower one is born in the inclusion of the coupling in the Rosh of the upper one; but when its coarseness is recognized, it leaves there and descends to its place.
And besides the above, there are further discernments of HG that come out in the coupling in the Partzuf, and are regarded in it as not permanent. This is because the lower one receives no illumination whatsoever, except from Ein Sof; and when the abundance passes from Ein Sof to the lower ones, it passes through all the Partzufim that precede the lower one, and this abundance is called by the upper ones not permanent in them, because it is not for their own need. And there are further matters in this, and they will be explained in their place.
